title: Negating a restriction assignment
statement: Given an assignment of restriction states to the $n$ coordinates, its negation is the assignment obtained by negating the state at every coordinate: free states remain free, and the two fixed states are exchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
